verdict.rationale: A paper, fax, or mail fallback for business filings is a fair question for a state filing office, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no published mailing addresses, fax numbers, or paper filing forms for Secretary of State filings. The only nearby items are a Department of Taxation forms library and in-person tax help, which do not cover SOS filings. The SOS site and Business Central both returned 403 at robots.txt, so nothing documenting a non-online rail could be read.
